misconception_description: Student believes that colons (:) are used for variable assignment.

solutions.generated_code:
program BilanganTerbesarDariDigit
kamus
  d1, d2, d3, d4, temp : integer
algoritma
  input(d1, d2, d3, d4)
  if d1 < d2 then
    temp : d1
    d1 : d2
    d2 : temp
  endif
  if d2 < d3 then
    temp : d2
    d2 : d3
    d3 : temp
  endif
  if d3 < d4 then
    temp : d3
    d3 : d4
    d4 : temp
  endif
  if d1 < d2 then
    temp : d1
    d1 : d2
    d2 : temp
  endif
  if d2 < d3 then
    temp : d2
    d2 : d3
    d3 : temp
  endif
  if d1 < d2 then
    temp : d1
    d1 : d2
    d2 : temp
  endif
  output(d1 * 1000 + d2 * 100 + d3 * 10 + d4)
endprogram

metadata.modification_notes: The student replaced all variable assignment operators (=) with colons (:) because they believe colons are used for variable assignment. The changes are: 'n = len(arr)' became 'n : len(arr)', 'num = arr[0]' became 'num : arr[0]', and 'num = num * 10 + arr[i]' became 'num : num * 10 + arr[i]'. Note that the keyword argument 'reverse = True' in the sort() method call was left unchanged, as the student likely understands that function call syntax uses = for parameters. This code will produce a SyntaxError when executed.
